title: ROMA: concrete and terrazzo in 600×1200 and 800×1600 formats
excerpt: The new ROMA collection is devoted to large format: 600×1200 and 800×1600 slabs with concrete and terrazzo looks. We explain why large format is the designers' choice today.
body:
ROMA is the DADO brand of modern minimalism. In the new collection its core idea is at its clearest: minimal joints, calm texture and a large plane. The collection comes in 600×1200 and 800×1600 formats.

The concrete-look series is offered in grey and warm greige tones with a light, even texture. The terrazzo series comes in two variants, fine and coarse chip, which can be combined in one room.

Why large format? First, fewer joints: the surface looks seamless and is easier to clean. Second, the room visually expands. Third, a large slab does not compete with furniture and lighting; it works as a quiet backdrop.

Large format sets its own requirements for installation: a level base, suitable adhesive and an experienced tiler. In our showroom we give advice on these matters and help choose a laying pattern.

The collection is intended for walls and floors, with a matt finish. Samples are available in our Tashkent showroom, and orders are delivered to every region of Uzbekistan.
